fix_plan.description: Minimal surgical fix for Server returns 500 error on POST /api/auth/login after latest deployment

files_to_modify.rationale: bcrypt.checkpw requires bytes but user.password_hash is a string

fix_plan.patch:
--- a/app/routes/auth.py
+++ b/app/routes/auth.py
@@ -49,7 +49,7 @@
     # causing a TypeError: a bytes-like object is required, not 'str'
     is_valid = bcrypt.checkpw(
         payload.password.encode("utf-8"),
-        user.password_hash
+        user.password_hash.encode("utf-8")
     )

     if not is_valid:
fix_plan.rationale: bcrypt.checkpw requires bytes but user.password_hash is a string
